hook.name: LaunchHook
hook.description: Single-pool ETH/token hook that takes a tiered fee on every swap: a 1.5% base fee on the ETH side plus a buy surcharge that decays linearly from 49% to 0% over 15 seconds post-launch. Fees accumulate as ERC-6909 ETH claims payable only to a fixed fee recipient. External liquidity additions are blocked for 24 hours after launch, and any sell that pushes the price above the launch price is reverted.
